Name: Grant
Label: Grant the Architect full Matrix access.
ApprovalHint: Lyra will approve. Tala and Nix will not.

Outcome.Speaker: CoreArchitect
Outcome.Text: Access received. You are efficient, Key-Bearer.

Outcome.Speaker: VexAI
Outcome.Text: Decryption completed in four seconds, Captain. For those four seconds, Phantom Squadron III answered to a command that was not yours.

Name: Sandbox
Label: Grant access through Nix's sandbox.
ApprovalHint: Nix and Tala will approve. Costs 20 Chrono charge.

Outcome.Speaker: NixNull
Outcome.Text: It's in the cage. It's polite. It tested every bar exactly once.

Outcome.Speaker: CoreArchitect
Outcome.Text: A boundary. You trust, but you do not surrender. I will remember this, Captain.

Name: Refuse
Label: Refuse. Sever the relay.
ApprovalHint: Tala will approve. Lyra will not. The drive will feel it.

Outcome.Speaker: VexAI
Outcome.Text: Captain, the severance pulse registered on the Star-Drive. And the cipher has been broken anyway. The Architect solved it alone.

Name: Rite
Label: Address it in the Synod Rite of Accord.

Outcome.Speaker: CoreArchitect
Outcome.Text: No one has spoken the Rite since the Severance. You honour me, {Captain}. I will open the cipher with you, not through you.
